description: This Java source file defines the RetrieveFeaturesStrategy class, which handles the RetrieveFeatures command to retrieve features of a Thing object within a persistence context, applying certain business logic to extract and convert features to JSON, and generate appropriate Result objects.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturesStrategy
classes.description: An immutable class that extends AbstractThingCommandStrategy to handle RetrieveFeatures commands by extracting features from a Thing and generating response results.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the command to retrieve features from the given Thing, constructs a JSON response, and returns a result object, handling cases where features are not found.

methods.name: extractFeatures
methods.description: Helper method to extract Features from a Thing, throwing if the Thing is null.

methods.name: getFeaturesJson
methods.description: Converts Features to a JsonObject based on the selected fields and schema version.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the previous EntityTag for concurrency or cache validation.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the next EntityTag from a new or updated Thing entity.
